sources.title: New ADFC Cashback Rebate Overview (Abu Dhabi Film Commission)
sources.said: The base rate of the scheme has increased from 30% to 35%. In addition, there is now the potential for eligible productions to claim up to 50% rebate on qualifying spend in Abu Dhabi … Abu Dhabi Qualifying Production Expenditure (ADQPE) focuses entirely on below-the-line expenditure … 85 points and above = 15% uplift (50% total rebate) … NEW REBATE CAPS FROM 1 JANUARY 2025 … Feature Films: US$10m (US$500,000 for post-production only projects) … Television Programme or Series: US$2m (US$300,000 for post-production only projects) … Productions which employ a UAE National in one or more specific above-the-line cast and crew roles (Writer, Director, Stunt Coordinator, Stunt Performer or Lead Cast): 20 points

figures.finding: Abu Dhabi's cashback rebate is 35% of qualifying below-the-line spend in the emirate (ADQPE) from 1 January 2025, rising by points to as much as 50%; caps are US$10 million for a feature film or high-end drama series and US$2 million for other TV programmes.
